subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

A sits fourth to the left of Y. W sits fourth to the right of C. Only two people sit between Y and C when counted from the left of Y. X is not an immediate neighbour of W or Y. D is not an immediate neighbour of X. Who sits third to the right of B?
solution:
**Given:**

A sits fourth to the left of Y.

W sits fourth to the right of C.

Only two people sit between Y and C when counted from the left of Y.

X is not an immediate neighbour of W or Y.

D is not an immediate neighbour of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e737cbe92db7497d7af431c3345116ae6a8bc267e2291d607c06a64ee58cfe1.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is D**
